name: components/scroll-area
description: A composable scroll container primitive with custom scrollbar styling for vertical, horizontal, or two-axis overflow content. Includes ScrollArea, ScrollAreaViewport, ScrollAreaScrollbar, ScrollAreaThumb, and ScrollAreaCorner for building consistent scrolling regions in lists, galleries, and code panels.
useCases: Constrain long lists in cards or side panels while preserving layout stability
Enable horizontal browsing for media strips and dense data rows
Provide consistent themed scrollbar visuals across app sections
Support both-axis overflow for large canvases or grid-like content
